dedupe_keys.name: perma crops pt geolocated dataset of permanent crops in portugal 2019 census

description: Perma_Crops_PT maps the distribution of 14 permanent crops in Portugal by administrative unit, from the 2019 agricultural census of the national statistics institute INE. The Zenodo record lists almond, apple, chestnut, carob, sweet cherry, grapevine, olive, lemon, orange, walnut, mandarin, peach, pear and plum. It was published in May 2024 by researchers at the University of Trás-os-Montes and Alto Douro under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one GeoPackage of about 17 MB, with a Data in Brief paper. Coverage is Portugal. Caveats: values are census areas per administrative unit, not orchard polygons. For simulation it gives where vineyards, olive groves and orchards are, to model wildfire, drought and heat exposure of perennial crops. Related catalogue records include the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU and the harmonized IACS inventory.
name: Perma_Crops_PT - geolocated dataset of permanent crops in Portugal (2019 census)
provider: University of Trás-os-Montes and Alto Douro - Helder Fraga, Teresa Freitas, Nathalie Guimarães and João A. Santos, via Zenodo
